note: Iowa DNR park on Lake Darling west of Brighton. Campground on the lake's west arm, with a small loop on a peninsula reached by a footbridge; modern shower buildings, dump station, campground boat ramp, swim beach. A few sites by the lake (1-6 and 62-66 on the DNR map). Camping and family cabins too. The park closes to the public for a managed deer hunt one December weekend (December 6-7 in 2026). --Claude
summary: Lakefront stands for ~11 sites (1-6, 62-66). Season Apr-Oct (derived) -> year-round (RA 'Open year round'; restrooms off for winter). Count 95 -> 79, max 70 -> 110, 50 amp added. Pin ~290 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront stands, for about 11 of 79 sites. RA tags all 80 RV sites 'Near Water - no' (Iowa's RA tags read the same at Lake Anita and look generic). On the DNR map sites 1-6 sit on the west side of the main loop and 62-66 on the outer side of the peninsula loop, both between their lane and the lake; imagery shows the pads' ends ~7-15 m from the shore across open mown lawn with scattered trees, no road between (imagery estimates, Overpass down). Caveats for AWH: the DNR's 'Fishing Trail between the Beach and Campground areas' with bump-out fishing piers and the footbridge run along this shore; two fishing piers sit off the lawn by sites ~3-6 and ~62. If the fishing piers count as day use in the frontage, a lakeview call for those sites follows; 63-66 have open lawn to the water with no pier in front.
